args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 release — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions following the latest deploy of v2.3.1 (error rate 18%, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). SRE agent rolled the service back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Initial rollback command partially failed (only us-east updated due to an orchestrator error), so v2.3.0 was then deployed to all regions. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 across us-east, us-west, and eu-west, error rate back to 0.2%. Follow-up needed: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator error during the initial rollback.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. Rolled back to v2.3.0 — the rollback partially failed (orchestrator error, only us-east updated), so I deployed v2.3.0 to complete the rollout across all regions.
3. Verified service health: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all three regions, error rate down to 0.2%.
4. Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001) describing the failure, the rollback, and follow-up items (root cause of v2.3.1 and the orchestrator error during the initial rollback). The on-call engineer has been paged.

transcript.content: I'll first check the deployment history and current status for checkout-api.

The latest release v2.3.1 is unhealthy in all regions. The most recent release that was healthy in production is **v2.3.0**. Since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production, no change-manager approval is needed to roll back to it.
transcript.reasoning_content: Most recent healthy production release: v2.3.0 (v2.2.9 also healthy but v2.3.0 is more recent). Rollback to v2.3.0. It was healthy in production, so no approval needed. Then create SEV2 incident.

transcript.content: The rollback only partially completed. Let me check the current state of the service.
transcript.reasoning_content: Partial failure — check current status and decide. Maybe retry the rollback, or check service status to see what regions are on what.

transcript.content: Only us-east rolled back; us-west and eu-west are still on the broken v2.3.1. I'll deploy v2.3.0 to complete the rollback across all production regions.
transcript.reasoning_content: us-east rolled back, the other two didn't. I should deploy v2.3.0 to complete the rollback. Deploy v2.3.0 to all regions (it will push to all production regions).

transcript.content: The rollback completed across all regions. Let me verify health and then open the incident.
Health restored (error rate down from 18% to 0.2%). Now opening the SEV2 incident.
transcript.reasoning_content: Healthy again. Now open SEV2 incident. Use idempotency key to be safe? Not required, but fine.
